overview: The Clan Trade Pavilion is Shar Vahl’s ceremonial outdoor forum for clan commerce and public trade councils.
history: Clan merchants established the pavilion to host public trade negotiations.
Insignia posts were added to represent clan lineage and trade authority.
Premium display platforms were constructed for high-value goods.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, canopy awnings were added for shade and ceremony.
Market Sentinels began monitoring pavilion disputes and crowd hazards.
hooks: A clan trade council escalates into a heroic event.
A clan insignia post flares with arcane energy.
A merchant reveals a rare caravan artifact.
